description: Review of whether verified PIT ranks change interpretation of the null anchor result.
basis: PIT ranks are conservative upper bounds (earliest snapshot at/after formation date; rank can only fall after listing, not rise before it). The extended evaluation (EBCR-GRID-001-0005) anchor co-primaries crash_incidence_15pct and expected_shortfall_5pct_forward_mae were not significant (adj p 0.248, 0.949). The signal (extreme perpetual-futures basis) and crash labels are computed from per-symbol price/basis series, independent of universe rank. Rank verification affects only candidate-discovery/survivorship interpretation, not the tested association within the coverage cohort.
finding: No non-null implication. Verified PIT ranks do not alter the null anchor result; coverage-cohort conclusions stand. Exclusions 336 (missing_label) preserved. 324 cells ok. H002/H003 remain registered_secondary_not_tested.
